---
title: BioGRID
description: BioGRID's curated physical and genetic interactions, every organism, landed whole and stacked into annotation.interaction.
---

[BioGRID](https://thebiogrid.org) curates physical and genetic interactions
from the literature and publishes a numbered release monthly, every one kept
in its Release-Archive. The release lands `BIOGRID-ALL-x.y.zzz.tab3.zip`
whole: one row per curated interaction evidence, every organism and every
column, the latest release only (older ones stay citable upstream).

## Licence and citation

MIT; the notice travels in the table comments. Cite BioGRID as
[its site asks](https://wiki.thebiogrid.org/doku.php/citing_biogrid).

## Join keys

- The key is BioGRID's own interaction id, not the pair: one paper can report a pair twice under one experimental system.
- Interactors stay in BioGRID's identifier space: Entrez gene ids, or the BioGRID id where a molecule has no Entrez gene (the namespace column says which). Join `annotation.ncbi__gene.gene_id`, or map through `annotation.identifier_mapping`.
- The derived rows are in `annotation.interaction` under `source = 'BIOGRID'`, beside IntAct's.

## Good to know

- `detection_method_id` and `interaction_type_id` are NULL on BioGRID rows: the tab3 file carries BioGRID's own experimental-system vocabulary, not PSI-MI ids.
- The UniProt accessions BioGRID lists alongside are many-to-one per gene and stay in raw.
